title: Choose FinVault's look
question: The roll dealt The Household Passbook. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Household Passbook
options.lineage: Savings passbooks and the machine that printed new lines into them
options.thesis: Your household keeps one passbook; each statement you import prints new lines into it.
options.viewport: A plum cloth rail holds the page; the open page shows the newest imported lines, ruled date, description, out, in, balance, with Update book at the top.
options.risk: A passbook is a bank object; it must stay the household's own book, never a bank's branding.

raised.raise: The plum cloth owns the whole rail and page frame at full strength; no scattered accent colour.
One ruling measures everything: every row, figure and chart sits on the same line pitch and column grid.
States are named on the page: each import shows previewed, printed or undone, and each account its last-updated stamp.
Flat unmodulated colour only: no gradients, glass or grain anywhere.

regions.label: ruled entries: date · description · out · in · balance

options.label: The Accordion File
options.lineage: The expanding manila folder every household keeps its statements in
options.thesis: Each month is a pocket; importing a statement files it into that month's pocket.
options.viewport: A row of month tabs across the top; the open pocket lists that month's filed statements and transactions.
options.risk: Familiar skeuomorph; folders and tabs are what most file-first apps already look like.

options.label: Shoebox Stack
options.lineage: HyperCard stacks: every card readable and editable in place
options.thesis: Every transaction is a card you fix right where you read it.
options.viewport: A stack of transaction cards; the front card open for categorising, back links retracing your trail.
options.case: Holds product clarity (edit-in-place suits the monthly tidy-up) but loses audience identification, and one-bit monochrome drifts toward cold.
options.risk: Retro-novelty; reads clinical when the dithering is timid.

options.label: Seedbed Lobes
options.lineage: one saturated green field with floating white capsules
options.thesis: The interface floats as pills over one colour field.
options.viewport: Green field, floating capsule nav, cream slab below.
options.case: Loses both axes: reads as fintech marketing and too playful for this household.
options.kept: Total colour commitment: the cloth owns its region.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope on an etched graticule
options.thesis: Cash flow as a phosphor trace.
options.case: Loses both axes: clinical, and a trace can't carry categorising.
options.kept: One measuring grid for every figure.

options.label: Guide Map Lobes
options.thesis: Accounts as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.viewport: One lobe per area, coastlines dividing.
options.case: Loses both axes: playful, and lobes hide tabular data.

options.label: Drawcord Cape
options.thesis: One pull changes the whole form.
options.viewport: A flat semicircle gathering into shape.
options.case: Loses both axes: no link to household money.

options.label: Dawn Cyclorama
options.thesis: Months as light passing from night to day.
options.case: Loses both axes: atmosphere over data.
options.kept: Phases labelled so colour is never the only signal.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean personal-finance dashboard, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, headline totals, cards of charts and recent transactions.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other finance apps by design.
